verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a desktop OS can ship an app catalog with search and category filters. The evidence only shows an 'Install an application' doc title, a 'Thousands of applications' claim, and a list of popular apps (Firefox, Chrome, Steam); none of it documents searching or filtering a catalog by category. The community comment about typing 'calc' in the Dash concerns launching installed apps, not browsing a software catalog, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can search and filter the app catalog by category to find familiar software
